title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Tea Party on 1969-12-30
source: Recording Info: SBD -> Cass Master (Ampex C-90 Master Cass/no dolby) -> Cass (Tascam 122mkIII Cass 1st Gen) -> Dat (Technics 3800/44.1k) Transfer Info: Dat (Sony R500) -> Prodif Plus -> Samplitude v6.0 -> SHN

ai_review.summary: A pristine Charlie Miller‑tuned soundboard captures a high‑energy 12/30/69 show with a monster Dark Star/Alligator/Drums/The Eleven suite and killer New Speedway Boogie, Black Peter and Uncle John’s Band.
ai_review.review: The recording is an A+ soundboard mastered by Charlie Miller – clear, balanced and virtually free of flaws. Musically the concert is a fireworks‑filled romp, highlighted by a 20‑minute Dark Star > Alligator > Drums > The Eleven sequence and standout performances of New Speedway Boogie, Black Peter, Uncle John’s Band and The Other One. Energy runs high from start to finish, making this one of the most celebrated late‑’69 tapes.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently glowing 5‑star comments praise both the superb soundboard source and an exceptional, high‑energy performance; minor technical notes are negligible.

recording_quality.technical_notes: A+ Charlie Miller mix – crisp, well‑balanced with only very minor imperfections (slight vocal distortion at the extreme end), no dropouts or muffiness reported.

standout_songs: Dark Star > Alligator > Drums > The Eleven
show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, cohesive flow from an electrifying first set into a superb second set; jams lock in and maintain momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note Jerry's Gibson SG was “fired up” and his lead work on Uncle John’s Band is brilliant.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drum segment in the Dark Star > Alligator > Drums > The Eleven suite is highlighted as a strong, tight performance.
